title: fix: remove underline from model title links
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes the underline from model names in the Enter model list.
- Keeps titles clickable in Open WebUI and Play; other links are unchanged.

gist.headline: Titles lose the underline
gist.blurb: The Enter model list looks a little tidier. Model titles still open Open WebUI or Play; they’ve just stopped dressing like links.
gist.summary: Removed underlines from model titles in the Enter model list while keeping Open WebUI and Play titles clickable and leaving other links unchanged.
gist.impact: Users get cleaner model rows without losing the title shortcuts to Open WebUI and Play.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Enter’s model list as a cozy retro screen with clean, clickable model titles and small Open WebUI and Play signposts. Polli, wearing tiny reading glasses, checks the tidier list beside a few code-plants; the scene is about visual polish, not removing links.
